items.subtext: Take your party directly to Campaign to defeat the Covenant, save the galaxy, and finish the fight!
Take your party to Xbox LIVE and into the frenetic action of live combat, objective-based missions, and dangerous military exercises.
Take your party to combat and objective-based missions that you select and design. Your rules, your maps, your game.
Take your party to collaborate in real time to edit and play variations of your favorite maps, from the subtle to the insane.
Take your party to view and replay films and footage of your Halo 3 exploits, from Campaign, to Multiplayer, to Forge Mode.
